notes: First-party launch material establishes an exact BTCC Earn launch date of 2026-02-11. Current support defines BTCC Earn as an interest-earning product with Flexible Earn and Fixed Earn. Flexible Earn settles interest hourly and permits redemption at any time; Fixed Earn is currently a fixed-term new-user product, with early redemption forfeiting interest. Statements that principal and interest return to the wallet describe product mechanics, not independently verified universal repayment. BTCC's launch and milestone pages advertise up to 20% APY for Flexible Earn and a 300% APY two-day new-user fixed-term promotion; preserve those strictly as issuer-advertised rates and conditions. The current Simple Earn surface warns that annualized return does not represent actual or guaranteed return. Current first-party privacy/support surfaces identify BTCC POLAND LIMITED as BTCC, registered in Lodz, Poland, while legacy pre-2026 EU account services could involve BTCC Lithuania Limited UAB and product access remains jurisdiction-dependent; use Poland / jurisdiction-dependent rather than infer one universal entity for every historical account. No insolvency, platform-wide withdrawal freeze, haircut, or customer-claims event is established by this review.
